basic.name: Make Some Noise
basic.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Let the Storm Rage On
skill.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to all enemies and gains 20 point(s) of "Certified Banger."

ultimate.name: May the Trailblaze Fly You Starward
ultimate.description_template:
Gains 5 Punchline point(s). Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally by {{scaling1}}% for 3 turn(s), and dispels Crowd Control debuffs on them.
If the target has Elation Skill, they additionally gain 10 point(s) of "Certified Banger" and immediately use their Elation Skill 1 time, taking into account a fixed amount of 20 Punchline point(s).
If the enemy target is defeated before the Elation Skill is unleashed, then the Elation Skill is instead launched on a newly entering enemy target. If the target does not have Elation Skill, their action advances by 50%.

talent.name: That Smile Hits Different
talent.description_template:
After using an attack, regenerates a fixed amount of 10 Energy and gains 3 Punchline point(s).
When the Trailblazer holds "Certified Banger," their Skill additionally deals {{scaling1}}% Lightning Elation DMG to all enemies. This DMG is calculated using the highest "Certified Banger" value among all allies.

technique.name: We Are So Back!
technique.description:
After using Technique, randomly gains 1 of the following effects:
A low chance to gain "Hearty Laughter": Increases Elation by 30%.
A high chance to gain "Irrepressible Laughter": Increases Elation by 20%.
When the next battle begins, increases all allies' Elation stat by the corresponding amount for 3 turn(s).

skill.name: I Said "Elation," Did I Stutter?
skill.description_template: Deals 8 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing {{scaling1}}% Lightning Elation DMG to one random enemy. At last, deals {{scaling2}}% Lightning Elation DMG, which is split evenly among all enemies.

2.name: On Cloud Nine
2.description: For every 200 point(s) of Trailblazer's ATK that exceeds 1000, increases this unit's Elation stat by 10%, up to a maximum increase of 60%.

4.name: Screw It, We Ball
4.description: Increases this unit's CRIT Rate by 15%. After using Ultimate, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) for the team.

6.name: Aha, Sic 'Em!
6.description: After an ally target uses Elation Skill, Trailblazer additionally gains 2 point(s) of "Certified Banger" the next time they use their Skill.

eidolons.name: Believe In the Light
eidolons.description: After using Skill, the next Ultimate increases the amount of "Certified Banger" gained by ally targets by 2. This effect can stack up to 3 time(s).

eidolons.name: History in the Making...
eidolons.description: Ultimate additionally increases the Elation of one designated ally by 12%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Into the Spotlight
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Save the World. Just Because.
eidolons.description: When using Elation Skill, increases the DMG taken by enemy targets by 10%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Love & Courage: Always in Style
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: The Cosmic Legend Cometh!
eidolons.description: When using Elation Skill, increases this unit's CRIT DMG by 100% for 3 turns.
